releases.name: supervisor-workflow
releases.description: Supervisor host, review and remote-control reliability, shipped from the supervisor container-use environment and seen by the people who run review and wake the host.

clusters.title: Host shutdown and review-job safety
clusters.description: Shutdown must not stop running review jobs, must not duplicate published findings on restart, and must bound workspace discovery before the hard-cap poweroff.

clusters.title: Success and failure reporting in host and review status
clusters.description: Empty findings, completed PID files, DevPod status and snapshot inventory failures are all reported as the wrong outcome, and host_wake reports ready before the webhook is verified.

clusters.title: Remote Control usable from the supervisor
clusters.description: Remote Control needs a token with full scope and a live bridge running between ticks, or it is not usable from the supervisor.

clusters.title: Duo standalone page for the native client
clusters.description: The iPhone Duo editor loads a generated, self-contained page with bundled Monaco and the claim JSON, and the stale-preview and option-card fixes go with it.

clusters.title: DevPod worker and supervisor workspaces
clusters.description: Provision the independent worker and supervisor workspaces through the existing GCE path, with readiness verified, and keep the local test suite runnable.

clusters.title: Review agent dispatch protects work in flight
clusters.description: The review dispatch prompt must protect in-flight and stacked work, and the drift monitor checks that dispatch and completion evidence agree.
